content: The MST-kNN construction has the advantage of its simplicity and robustness, and the fact that it balances the local and global structure of the data. However, the area of network inference and graph construction from data, and graph sparsification is very active, and several alternative approaches exist based on different heuristics, e.g., Graphical Lasso BIBREF26 , Planar Maximally Filtered Graph BIBREF27 , spectral sparsification BIBREF28 , or the Relaxed Minimum Spanning Tree (RMST) BIBREF29 . We have experimented with some of those methods and obtained comparable results. A detailed comparison of sparsification methods as well as the choice of distance in defining the similarity matrix $\hat{S}$ is left for future work.
